findings.problem: The two fields hom_inv_id and inv_hom_id of ψ are the same pullback.hom_ext argument with τ.hom and τ.inv swapped (fst component: lift_fst twice, reassociate, cancel τ-composition; snd component: lift_snd twice, id_comp). The pullback.lift-of-an-endomorphism reasoning is written out twice in a long inline structure.
findings.proposed_change: State a small lemma in DivShiftAsm: for f : Z ⟶ B, g : B' ⟶ B (here 𝟙 base) and a b : Z ⟶ Z with a ≫ f = f, b ≫ f = f and a ≫ b = 𝟙 Z, the map pullback.lift (pullback.fst f g ≫ a) (pullback.snd f g) _ composed with the analogous map for b equals 𝟙 (pullback f g). Proof: pullback.hom_ext; fst component by lift_fst, ← assoc, lift_fst, assoc, hab, comp_id; snd by lift_snd twice. Then set hom_inv_id := lemma τ.hom τ.inv hτ hτ' τ.hom_inv_id and inv_hom_id := lemma τ.inv τ.hom hτ' hτ τ.inv_hom_id. This also lets the hom/inv lifts be named once instead of being restated (the hom lift is also restated verbatim in the theorem statement).
findings.benefit: Removes duplicated categorical bookkeeping, makes the proof of ψ an isomorphism a two-line use of a reusable fact, and shortens the main proof so the real mathematical content (shift on the Z/q grid) is easier to see.

findings.problem: hσdiv and hσmod each re-derive the same nontrivial identity finProdFinEquiv.symm (σ j) = (j.divNat, finRotate (q'+1) j.modNat) with an identical simp [σ, Equiv.trans_apply, Equiv.symm_apply_apply, Equiv.prodCongr_apply, finProdFinEquiv_symm_apply] block, then project to one component each.
findings.proposed_change: Prove once, right after defining σ: have hσsymm : ∀ j : Fin ((q'+1)*(q'+1)), finProdFinEquiv.symm (σ j) = (j.divNat, finRotate (q'+1) j.modNat) := fun j => by simp [σ, Equiv.trans_apply, Equiv.symm_apply_apply, Equiv.prodCongr_apply, finProdFinEquiv_symm_apply]. Then in hσdiv and hσmod use h := congrArg Prod.fst (finProdFinEquiv_symm_apply (σ j)) / congrArg Prod.snd, rewrite with hσsymm j at h, and continue with the existing Fin.coe_divNat / finRotate_succ_apply steps unchanged.
findings.benefit: Single place for the σ decomposition, so changing σ requires one edit, and the two arithmetic facts visibly depend on one shared computation; removes about six duplicated lines of long simp/rw.
